messages:
marta_csm: Weekly dedicated-capacity check for tenant 'acme' — quick snapshot and blockers.
marta_csm: TL;DR: GPU hours down slightly WoW (-6%) but peak saturation spiked to ~93% on Wed causing queue depth to jump and some p95 latency deterioration. Need infra + eng input before renewal conversation next Wed.
infra-bot: [alert] pool=acme-res1 saturation=93% peak queued=78 avg_queue_depth=34 gpu_hours=2840 (7d)
ryan_infra: Saw the Wed spike — a large offline eval run from acme-dev triggered many long-context requests. Autoscale hit max and queued started growing.
ryan_infra: Current autoscale config: min=4, max=12, scale_window=60s, burst=1. We hit max because the eval used sequence lengths >> typical.
jamie_eng: Can we throttle long-context evals or route them to a lower-priority GPU tier? Also recommend enabling prefix KV caching for that tenant to reduce repeated prefills.
jamie_eng: Quick config snippet to add a priority route:
```
routes:
  - tenant: acme
    priority: standard
  - tenant: acme-evals
    priority: low
    max_concurrency: 6
```
ryan_infra: Also propose increasing burst to 2 for the pool and a short-term manual scale to 14 while we validate routing.
```
redwoodctl capacity adjust --pool acme-res1 --max 14 --burst 2
```
sophie_account: FYI I spoke with Acme CSM this morning — they're nervous about latency regressions; renewal discussion booked next Wed. They want a clear mitigation plan and a short enablement doc for their engineering team.
oliver_ce: On spend — billing shows acme's dedicated hours are +12% month-over-month because of the eval runs. We should include a cost breakdown in the recap for renewals.
ryan_infra: I'll run a hotspot analysis across the week and produce a short graph (p50/p95 latency, queue depth, saturation per hour). ETA EOD today.
jamie_eng: I'll prepare a recommended config (route + batching + cache) and a fallback model-variant that uses 4-bit quantization for cheap evals.
marta_csm: Action items:
- ryan_infra: manual scale + burst now, run hourly hotspot, post graphs in thread (ETA EOD) @ryan_infra
- jamie_eng: config + fallback model plan + short enablement blurb for Acme eng (ETA tomorrow) @jamie_eng
- oliver_ce: prepare cost variance table for renewal deck (ETA tomorrow) @oliver_ce
- sophie_account: schedule a 30m enablement call with Acme eng and share the blurb (ETA tomorrow) @sophie_account
marta_csm: OK to bump now? If everyone 👍 I'll ask infra to execute the manual scale and I'll draft the customer note.
ryan_infra: 👍 executing scale now, will post the job id and confirmation once done.
infra-bot: [job] id=job-8921 status=running action=scale pool=acme-res1 target_max=14
marta_csm: Thanks — post the graphs when available and I'll assemble the renewal brief. :thumbsup:
oliver_ce: I'll start the cost table and flag any unusual line items. If we need, we can propose a short-term trial discount tied to throughput SLAs.
jamie_eng: Noted, will include recommended guardrails for eval runs (rate limits + routing) in the blurb.
ryan_infra: job complete. id=job-8921 status=success new_max=14 burst=2. Early indicators: queue depth down ~60% in first 20m.
infra-bot: pool=acme-res1 saturation=67% queued=12 avg_latency_p95=420ms p50=78ms
marta_csm: Great, thanks team. I'll paste a one-pager for Acme after we have the cost table and graphs. Meeting prep next Tue at 10am.
